text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our initial meeting wrapped up and 
we stepped out of the chairwoman's 
office...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now then. If I recall correctly, you are 
Sirius's Trainer as well, yes?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let's head to the student 
council room together. The Symboli family 
members have invited me over, you see."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as I was walking alongside Speed 
Symboli toward the student council room...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—H-Hey, isn't that...! —They're really 
walking around campus... —It's the real 
deal...

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
—What an incredible aura... —She's usually 
overseas, right? —She really is in a 
completely different league.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
He doesn't show his face much. Well, I'm 
sure things will settle down eventually.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! G-Good work today! ...Oh man, she 
waved back at me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's a pleasure to see you again, Ms. 
Speed Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot thank you enough for all your 
help this time. ...Truly, words cannot 
express my gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No need to be so formal with me. We're 
family, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I have heard from all corners of your 
great success, truly exemplifying how 
boundless the world is. It is only natural 
to pay respect to such a great 
predecessor."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Honestly... as serious as ever.
choice_data_list:
(Whoa, there's so much amazing stuff going 
on...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The solemn demeanors of Symboli Rudolf the 
"Emperor" and Symboli Kris S the "Black 
Monarch," as well as my own presence 
beside them.
choice_data_list:
(She is a legendary Umamusume, after 
all...)

(She really is a legendary Umamusume, 
isn't she...)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I heard Sirius is finally making her debut 
this year. How's she doing?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Not bad. —So don't butt in too much.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, even if they butt in, I'll hype 
things up so hard it won't even matter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"My, my, Lady 'Emperor.' Do you have an 
opinion to share?"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Sounds good to me, Rudolf. ...So, 
what kind of plan do you have in mind?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —The world.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna take the world. In a world sky 
no one has claimed yet, I'm gonna shine."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not that I give a damn about hyping up the 
Twinkle Series, but... If I do this, the 
crowds'll go wild on their own, right?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Is that so? I'm looking forward to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew full well how fearless Sirius 
Symboli was, but... to think she'd keep up 
that exact same attitude with Speed 
Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her audacity was so completely different 
from mine that I could only stare in blank 
amazement.
